strategy.offer: Interior decoration and upholstery textiles, plus made-to-measure sewing, custom samples, and retail presentation support.
strategy.customers: Retail trade and other buyers seeking interior textiles with dependable supply, sampling, and service.
strategy.why_we_win: They combine design-led collections with quick delivery, broad in-stock availability, reorder continuity, and attentive customer service built around feedback.
strategy.resources: An international organization with about 120 employees, efficient electronic order handling, a large stocked warehouse, and sewing and sample-making capabilities.
